subject: [PATCH v4 11/14] selftests/nfsd: exercise listener_set request validation

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch adds regression tests for the NFSD_CMD_LISTENER_SET checks in the NFS server (NFSD) code. The tests cover various invalid listener set requests, including bad transport names, missing addresses, and malformed entries. The tests use a stub to simulate the creation of an NFS service and run in their own network namespace. The patch also updates the MAINTAINERS file and adds a new directory for the NFSD selftests.
